desc: Retailer delivering an immersive in-store experience with smartphones, smartwatches & more.
addr: 514, next to ICICI Bank, Defence Colony, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038, India

rev.t: Well maintained showroom. Neat and clean. The staffs are very friendly, especially Mr. Pandu. He convinced me to buy the mobile.
Good supporting help by the shop owner to get my new device arrangement of icons in a systematic way, shows much patience and respect which is quality of vendor.

Visited this Samsung store expecting some assistance, but unfortunately the experience was disappointing. The staff did not seem interested in helping or providing product details. There was hardly anyone available to attend to customers, …
